ideas.pitch: An AI-powered mentorship and networking platform matching underrepresented womxn students in STEM with London-based industry professionals using semantic profile matching.
ideas.title: STEMConnect London
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses diversity and inclusion in STEM which deeply resonates with the core mission of the IKU Womxn in STEM Hackathon judges.

ideas.pitch: A satellite and AI-driven monitoring web app to track urban green spaces and biodiversity in London boroughs, providing actionable data for local sustainability initiatives.
ideas.title: BioTrace Carbon
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a clear, measurable environmental impact and spatial data visualization similar to winning industrial monitoring platforms.

ideas.pitch: A community-driven safety routing and companion app that groups lone commuters and students traveling late at night across London via public transport.
ideas.title: SafeReturn London
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a daily, highly relevant personal safety problem that students and judges living and commuting in London experience directly.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized micro-task marketplace connecting London tech startups with student developers for short-term coding sprints, with instant escrow payouts.
ideas.title: SkillBridge Micro-Interships
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a frictionless gig-economy workflow with automated escrow payments, following proven marketplace architectures.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered symptom checker and clinical trial finder tailored specifically to address historical gender health data gaps.
ideas.title: HealthEquity AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a well-documented healthcare disparity using explainable AI models, appealing strongly to impact-focused judges.
